identity: ONE original adult woman healer, the Dewglass Restorer veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep her brown braided hair with small white flowers, the green scarf, the white embroidered long apron over layered green leaf and leather armour, the brown bark bracers, greaves and boots. On her back is a root-frame backpack carrying ONE large translucent cyan glass mushroom canopy above and behind her head, ONE round cyan dew flask hanging at screen left, and ONE flexible green hose curving from the backpack to ONE hand-held bulbous glass sprayer with a leafy flower nozzle pointing to screen right. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs: the screen-left hand holds the sprayer grip, the screen-right hand supports it under the glass chamber. Preserve the canopy, flask, hose, sprayer and the adult proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the whole glass canopy, the flask, the hose, the sprayer nozzle, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, spray mist, droplets, bubbles, magic, glow, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. The canopy stays attached to the backpack and the hose never disconnects. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the glass equipment.

idle_h3_v1.action: A calm, attentive idle that loops. She breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, she lifts the sprayer a little and checks the nozzle, the dew sloshes gently in the flask, the head turns slightly and the glass canopy sways a touch with her body, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no spraying.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with careful, steady steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. The sprayer is carried low in both hands, the hose swaying and the canopy steady on the backpack; the apron swings with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE sprayer jab toward screen right. She draws the sprayer back to her hip as the knees bend, then lunges forward on the front leg and jabs the flower nozzle out with both arms to full reach at screen right, pulls it back and settles into the original stance. One jab only; nothing is sprayed.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Spray ONE dose toward screen right. She raises the sprayer level and aims the flower nozzle at screen right, squeezes the grip so the glass bulb pumps once and the sprayer kicks slightly, holds a moment, then lowers it and settles into the original stance. The spray itself is not shown: no mist, droplets or glow.

hit_h3_v1.action: She flinches from an unseen blow and recovers completely. The head snaps back and the shoulders twist away, the knees flex and the canopy rocks with the backpack while both hands keep hold of the sprayer, then she rebalances on both boots and returns to the same stance. Nothing is seen hitting her: no projectile, spark or flash. The blue background never flashes or changes colour.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low on bent knees, hunch under the glass canopy and hold the sprayer close across the chest, shielding it with the shoulder turned in, then hold the low covered guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A blessing gesture. She releases one hand from the sprayer and raises it high with the palm open toward the sky, holding the sprayer low in the other hand, holds the pose briefly, then returns the hand to the sprayer in the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly from standing. She doubles over and sinks onto her knees with the sprayer dropping, stays kneeling a moment, then slumps forward and lies down on her front, finishing motionless with the head at screen right and the boots at screen left, the glass canopy tipped over on the ground still attached to the backpack and the sprayer lying by her hand on its hose. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no shattering glass and no disappearing body.
